2105-3603-6633-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-6633-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-6633-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2829-5267-7924.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

225-1021-6303-6620.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
225-1021-6303-6620.notes: Do not resolve the ability from step 5, and target the same creature each iteration.

1563-1867-2206-5270-7810.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3703-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-3703-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-2829-5131-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1308-5086-5183-5231-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-5086-5183-5231-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

104-5070-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5070-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-6664-6681-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
There's another land on the battlefield.
3678-6664-6681-6879.description:
Play Strip Mine.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Strip Mine.
Activate Strip Mine's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting another land.
Haru triggers, returning Strip Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 2.
3678-6664-6681-6879.notes: You can use this combo as a lock, destroying any lands you wish as they enter. To do this combo infinitely, simply target the same land each loop while keeping the Strip Mine abilities on the stack.

240-4452-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4452-5686.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

851-1563-2457-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

698-1621-6867.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-1621-6867.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've gained this turn.
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

955-2085-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5147-5310-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

539-6798-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-549-4853-6797.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

602-1742-3591-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Necropotence and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Necropotence trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2281-2292-3305.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1429-4875-5226-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5226-5402.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

710-1703-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

678-2921-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-2921-4766.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

790-1972-4179.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-1972-4179.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Nekusar triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

1323-1606-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Morphling and Ley Weaver each have at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1323-1606-5137.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.
You may tap an additional land each cycle to get infinite mana, and you may then use Experiment Kraj's ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

2608-5168-5256-5542.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a black or red permanent
2608-5168-5256-5542.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2608-5168-5256-5542.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Derevi's power.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.

3000-5070-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5070-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2-851-2034-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

396-1409-3129-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-1409-3129-4050.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2493-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3480-3952-4050-4893.description:
Activate Purphoros by paying {R}, putting Firestorm Phoenix onto the battlefield from your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Firestorm Phoenix, adding {R}.
Firestorm Phoenix is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard.
Repeat.

1434-3846-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least six cards in hand with different mana values.
1434-3846-4711.description:
Declare Atemsis as an attacker.
Atemsis' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Atemsis tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using each Atemsis, triggering their abilities.
Resolve each Atemsis trigger, causing you to reveal your hand and causing each opponent to lose the game.

1283-1328-2011-4036.notablePrerequisites:
Spellbinder attached to Najeela.
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Najeela.
1283-1328-2011-4036.description:
Declare Najeela as an attacker.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Najeela.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Seething Song without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {5}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.

2757-3000-3340.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squirrel, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

24-3619.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Intervention Pact by paying {0}, preventing all damage dealt by Wheel of Misfortune to you, and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number, and causing you to gain life equal to the number you chose if you chose the largest number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

4050-4120-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vigor, adding one mana of any color.
Vigor dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Vigor trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Vigor, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
